evidence.detail: The record stores source text, substring start/end, rectangular x/y bounds, a region-kind boolean and an optional tooltip object.
Its predicate checks whether a supplied point lies inside the stored half-open rectangle [x1,x2) x [y1,y2).
For tooltip-style regions, changes in source/bounds materialize or refresh the tooltip object from up to 240 characters of the registered source substring.
The class is created and consumed only by InteractiveTextRegionRegistry and RSFont's link/tool markup registration path; it owns no unrelated rendering state.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for one hit-testable link/tool text span registered by RSFont.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 recognizes <link=...>/</link> and <tool=...>/</tool> while RSFont lays out rich text, and routes those spans into this class.
The class owns two fixed arrays of 256 interactive-region records plus active counters and reset/switch operations used during text layout.

Registered regions preserve source substring bounds plus screen rectangle bounds; the registry resolves the current region against Client mouse coordinates and can activate a flagged region by click coordinates.
Activation extracts the registered substring and dispatches it through Client.c(String); hover over tooltip-capable regions registers the associated tooltip object with the existing tooltip manager.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the shared link/tool rich-text region registry, hit-testing and activation service.
